messages:
carlos: Bank opened chargeback CB-1978001234 on OmegaPayments txn tx_Om9c ($9,850.00). Cardholder (SunPeak) claims duplicate billing/unauthorized. Hold applied to payout.
billing-bot: Automated: Chargeback CB-1978001234 created · merchant: OmegaPayments (mch_330) · hold applied to payout · evidence requested from merchant contact · response deadline: 5 days
tina: Can someone paste the txn metadata? amount, auth_time, acquirer_ref, last4, MCC?
carlos: Pasting ledger snippet:
```
transaction_id: tx_Om9c
amount: 9850.00
currency: USD
auth_time: 2026-03-21T10:22:17Z
acquirer_ref: ACQ-c9f3a
card_last4: 5566
merchant_id: mch_330
MCC: 5814
recurring: false
```
luke: MCC 5814 (fast food) is clearly wrong for OmegaPayments (B2B payment gateway). Flagging mapping oddity. For disputes we need invoice, signed contract or PO, settlement logs, and any onboarding KYC notes.
amy-legal: Bank will want proof of customer authorization + delivery of service. For gateways, a merchant-signed agreement plus customer acceptance (PO/email) is ideal. If merchant has phone verification logs or IPs showing customer initiated the charge, include them.
carlos: Omega uploaded invoice_9921.pdf and a signed sales order image. They also attached a CSV of account events showing creation and authentication at 2026-03-21T10:19:03Z from IP 198.51.100.101. Link: https://redwood-internal/s3/evidence/mch_330/tx_Om9c/packet.zip
ops-bot: Note: acquirer returned MCC=5814 but merchant expected 7399. Opening payments-ops ticket PAY-197800 to investigate MCC mapping.
tina: Good. Ask Omega for: 1) invoice matching amount and invoice id, 2) sales order or PO, 3) provisioning/account events with IPs, 4) any billing authorization email or signed mandate, 5) KYC export.
luke: Also request any support logs showing usage of gateway (payment attempts) and any merchant portal screenshots with timestamps. If merchant has customer email that authorized recurring or one-time charge, include it.
amy-legal: If there's no PO, I can draft a representment narrative referencing sales order + KYC + activation logs. Redact PII before upload.
carlos: Omega wants to fast-track because reserve is impacted. They uploaded invoice.pdf, sales_order.png, account_events.csv, kyc_redacted.txt. Evidence status updated.
billing-bot: Evidence uploaded to dispute CB-1978001234 by carlos: invoice.pdf, sales_order.png, account_events.csv, kyc_redacted.txt · status: evidence_pending_review
tina: I'll run timestamp checks and validate auth_time vs activation time. If logs line up, prepare representment packet. ETA EOD.
luke: Also follow up with payments-ops on PAY-197800 about MCC mapping; if mapping wrong it could affect dispute routing.
amy-legal: Reminder: representment window closes in 5 days. If anything missing, escalate now.
carlos: Thanks all — I'll keep Omega updated and ask them for any additional signed correspondence. Ping me if risk wants partial release review. :thumbsup:
